result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position: exclusivity is limited to the defined Deerskin Products category, lasts only 12 months from the Effective Date, and terminates automatically if HDI fails to meet applicable service levels, availability requirements, or delivery dates. It removes the broader restriction covering substantially similar products while preserving the original channel and brand scope. The changes are targeted and commercially coherent, though the inherited phrase “exclusive right to use of” is grammatically awkward and could be improved to “exclusive right to use.”
